_: The Cloudflare gate: the shipped source, type-checked with the RUNTIME's own types in scope — `ctx.storage` is the storage wrangler hands you, and a hibernatable socket is the runtime's. `deno check --config packages/durable-object/workers.json packages/durable-object/conform.ts` is the check; it is part of `deno task check`. It stands alone because those types are global: in scope, every other file in the repo would be checked against a Worker it does not run in.
